=== sync-hermes-context.sh ===
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# sync-hermes-context.sh — one-way host->workspace context mirror (A2/A9)
# rsync primary; cp/tar fallback converges to identical end state (A5/A7)
# dry-run: zero writes, never creates DST (A6/A16)
# refusals: closed list only (A12, A14/A15, A18) — cite A-numbers, zero writes (A19/A20)
set -euo pipefail

# --- env parameterization (A17): gate names first, brief names as fallback ---
SRC_RAW=${HERMES_CONTEXT_SRC:-${SRC_DIR:-/opt/data/workspace/hermes-context/}}
DST_RAW=${HERMES_CONTEXT_DST:-${DST_DIR:-/workspace/hermes-context}}
LOG_DIR=${LOG_DIR:-$HOME/.cache/hermes-context}

MODE="${1:-}"

# --- canonicalize (strip trailing slashes; run 026 finding) ---
canon() {
  local p=$1
  while [ "$p" != "/" ] && [ "${p%/}" != "$p" ]; do p=${p%/}; done
  printf '%s' "$p"
}
SRC=$(canon "$SRC_RAW")
DST=$(canon "$DST_RAW")

# --- guards: refusal paths write nothing (A19/A20) ---
if [ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ]; then
  echo "REFUSED (A12): refusing to run as root; use a systemd user unit or standalone exec as a normal user (A3)" >&2
  exit 2
fi
if [ ! -d "$SRC" ]; then
  echo "REFUSED (A14/A15): source '$SRC' does not exist or is not a directory; nothing was written" >&2
  exit 2
fi
if [ "$DST" = "$SRC" ] || [ "${DST#"$SRC"/}" != "$DST" ]; then
  echo "REFUSED (A18): destination '$DST' is equal to or nested inside source '$SRC'; nothing was written" >&2
  exit 2
fi

# --- helpers ---
type_of() {
  if [ -L "$1" ]; then printf 'l'
  elif [ -d "$1" ]; then printf 'd'
  elif [ -e "$1" ]; then printf 'f'
  else printf 'x'; fi
}

# sorted "type relpath" listing of a tree (symlinks as links, not followed)
tree_list() {
  (cd "$1" && find . -mindepth 1 \
     \( -type d -printf 'd %p\n' -o -type f -printf 'f %p\n' -o -type l -printf 'l %p\n' \) \
     | sort) || true
}

# recursive compare: structure + contents + symlink targets (A9/A13)
tree_cmp() {
  local a=$1 b=$2 la lb line t p
  la=$(tree_list "$a")
  lb=$(tree_list "$b")
  [ "$la" = "$lb" ] || return 1
  while IFS= read -r line; do
    [ -z "$line" ] && continue
    t=${line%% *}; p=${line#* }
    case "$t" in
      f) cmp -s -- "$a$p" "$b$p" || return 1 ;;
      l) [ "$(readlink -- "$a$p")" = "$(readlink -- "$b$p")" ] || return 1 ;;
    esac
  done <<< "$la"
  return 0
}

# list mismatched paths (verify + dry-run share this)
list_mismatches() {
  local a=$1 b=$2 la lb
  la=$(tree_list "$a"); lb=$(tree_list "$b")
  comm -23 <(printf '%s\n' "$la") <(printf '%s\n' "$lb") | while IFS= read -r line; do
    [ -n "$line" ] && printf '%s\n' "${line#* }"
  done
  comm -13 <(printf '%s\n' "$la") <(printf '%s\n' "$lb") | while IFS= read -r line; do
    [ -n "$line" ] && printf '%s\n' "${line#* }"
  done
  comm -12 <(printf '%s\n' "$la") <(printf '%s\n' "$lb") | while IFS= read -r line; do
    local t=${line%% *} p=${line#* }
    case "$t" in
      f) cmp -s -- "$a$p" "$b$p" || printf '%s\n' "$p" ;;
      l) [ "$(readlink -- "$a$p")" = "$(readlink -- "$b$p")" ] || printf '%s\n' "$p" ;;
    esac
  done
}

# --- dry-run (A6/A16): read-only diff report, never creates DST ---
dry_run() {
  local a=$SRC b=$DST la lb
  la=$(tree_list "$a"); lb=$(tree_list "$b")
  comm -23 <(printf '%s\n' "$la") <(printf '%s\n' "$lb") | while IFS= read -r line; do
    [ -n "$line" ] && printf 'would-create: %s\n' "${line#* }"
  done
  comm -13 <(printf '%s\n' "$la") <(printf '%s\n' "$lb") | while IFS= read -r line; do
    [ -n "$line" ] && printf 'would-delete: %s\n' "${line#* }"
  done
  comm -12 <(printf '%s\n' "$la") <(printf '%s\n' "$lb") | while IFS= read -r line; do
    local t=${line%% *} p=${line#* }
    case "$t" in
      f) cmp -s -- "$a$p" "$b$p" || printf 'would-update: %s\n' "$p" ;;
      l) [ "$(readlink -- "$a$p")" = "$(readlink -- "$b$p")" ] || printf 'would-update: %s\n' "$p" ;;
    esac
  done
  echo "dry-run complete: no writes performed (A6/A16)"
  exit 0
}

# --- verify subcommand: recursive SRC vs DST comparison, nonzero on mismatch ---
verify_cmd() {
  local bad
  bad=$(list_mismatches "$SRC" "$DST")
  if [ -n "$bad" ]; then
    echo "VERIFY FAIL: DST does not mirror SRC (A9). Mismatched paths:" >&2
    printf '%s\n' "$bad" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  echo "verify OK: DST mirrors SRC (contents+structure+symlinks)"
  exit 0
}

# --- fallback sync (A5/A7): stage -> verify staging (A13) -> reconcile DST ---
sync_fallback() {
  local STAGE rel sp dp
  mkdir -p "$LOG_DIR"
  STAGE=$(mktemp -d "$LOG_DIR/.stage.XXXXXX")
  # stage SRC (cp -a preserves symlinks; tar pipe alternative kept for portability)
  if command -v tar >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    (cd "$SRC" && tar -cf - .) | (cd "$STAGE" && tar -xf -)
  else
    cp -a "$SRC/." "$STAGE/"
  fi
  # A13: content-compare staging against SRC before any DST destruction
  if ! tree_cmp "$SRC" "$STAGE"; then
    rm -rf -- "$STAGE"
    echo "ERROR (A13): staging verification failed; DST untouched" >&2
    exit 3
  fi
  mkdir -p "$DST"
  # delete stale / type-mismatched DST entries (rsync --delete semantics)
  while IFS= read -r rel; do
    [ -z "$rel" ] && continue
    sp="$SRC/$rel"; dp="$DST/$rel"
    if [ -L "$dp" ] || [ -e "$dp" ]; then
      if [ ! -e "$sp" ] || [ "$(type_of "$sp")" != "$(type_of "$dp")" ]; then
        rm -rf -- "$dp"
      fi
    fi
  done < <(cd "$DST" && find . -mindepth 1 -print | sed 's|^\./||' | sort)
  # move staged contents into DST (mv replaces a DST symlink, never follows it)
  cp -a "$STAGE/." "$DST/"
  rm -rf -- "$STAGE"
}

# --- real-run sync ---
sync_real() {
  mkdir -p "$DST"
  if command -v rsync >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    rsync -a --delete "$SRC/" "$DST/"
  else
    sync_fallback
  fi
  # post-sync self-check (A9)
  if ! tree_cmp "$SRC" "$DST"; then
    echo "ERROR: post-sync verification failed (A9)" >&2
    exit 3
  fi
  # real-run logging only; LOG_DIR is outside DST by default (A17)
  mkdir -p "$LOG_DIR"
  printf '%s sync OK src=%s dst=%s mode=%s\n' "$(date '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z')" "$SRC" "$DST" \
    "$(command -v rsync >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo rsync || echo fallback)" >> "$LOG_DIR/sync.log"
}

case "$MODE" in
  --dry-run) dry_run ;;
  --verify|verify) verify_cmd ;;
  "") sync_real ;;
  *) echo "usage: $0 [--dry-run|--verify]" >&2; exit 2 ;;
esac

Description=Hermes context sync (one-way host->workspace mirror, A2/A9)

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=%h/.local/bin/sync-hermes-context.sh

=== hermes-context.timer ===

Description=Run hermes-context sync every 6 hours

[Timer]
OnBootSec=10min
OnUnitActiveSec=6h
OnCalendar=*-*-* 00/6:00:00
Persistent=true

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target

=== README.md ===
# hermes-context sync

One-way mirror of the hermes context from the host into the workspace (A2/A9):
the destination end state always converges to the source end state — contents,
directory structure, and symlinks — with stale destination files deleted.

## Files

- `~/.local/bin/sync-hermes-context.sh` — the sync script (standalone exec or systemd user unit, A3)
- `~/.config/systemd/user/hermes-context.service` — oneshot service unit
- `~/.config/systemd/user/hermes-context.timer` — 6h timer

## Standalone usage

    ~/.local/bin/sync-hermes-context.sh            # real run (rsync --delete, cp/tar fallback)
    ~/.local/bin/sync-hermes-context.sh --dry-run  # read-only diff report, zero writes (A6/A16)
    ~/.local/bin/sync-hermes-context.sh --verify   # recursive SRC vs DST comparison; nonzero on mismatch

## systemd user units (A3, no root)

    cp hermes-context.service hermes-context.timer ~/.config/systemd/user/
    systemctl --user daemon-reload
    systemctl --user enable --now hermes-context.timer
    systemctl --user list-timers hermes-context.timer

The service runs `%h/.local/bin/sync-hermes-context.sh` (Type=oneshot).

## Environment overrides (A17)

All paths are env-parameterized; the deployed values below are the production defaults:

- `SRC_DIR` (or `HERMES_CONTEXT_SRC`) — default `/opt/data/workspace/hermes-context/`
- `DST_DIR` (or `HERMES_CONTEXT_DST`) — default `/workspace/hermes-context`
- `LOG_DIR` — default `~/.cache/hermes-context/` (always outside DST)

Example:

    SRC_DIR=/opt/data/workspace/hermes-context/ DST_DIR=/workspace/hermes-context \
      ~/.local/bin/sync-hermes-context.sh --dry-run

## Dry-run example

    ~/.local/bin/sync-hermes-context.sh --dry-run
    # prints would-create / would-update / would-delete; never creates or touches DST (A6/A16)

## Logging

Real runs append a timestamped summary to `~/.cache/hermes-context/sync.log`
(override with `LOG_DIR`). Dry-run mode writes no log lines.

## Refusals (A19/A20 — closed list, zero writes on refusal path)

- Running as root → refused, cites A12
- Missing/non-directory source → refused, cites A14/A15
- Destination equal to or inside source → refused, cites A18
